So I am new to ED but the only way that I know how to make money is by trading. While I am really good at it. It can get boring at times. I never get into combat since that always ends badly. I was wondering what are some good ways to make money in the game?
What are some ways to make money in this game?

I did a lot of trading myself and recently have found out about going to the Resource Extraction Sites (RES). I have made a boat load of creds and sharpened my fighting skills. I know you said that you don't want to get into combat but take it from someone that has had his 6 shot down, even if you get beat up a bit you will get better at it! As a bonus, sometimes the AI will pitch in and help you down pirates!!

Trading, mining, bounty hunting, piracy, exploration.
Overall, mining seems to be the least profitable.
I have made most of my money so far with bounty hunting and exploration. Though exploration is a lot better when you have an Advanced Discovery Scanner, which is rather pricey at 1.5mio CR.
Combat is not that hard once you get the hang of it. Practice in a sidewinder and stay close to the local security.
Learn to use thrusters for fast turning, learn to stay behind your target, learn which weapons to use in what situation.

If you want, I can post the loadouts of my combat and exploration ships when I am at home. Both are rather cheap and pretty effective.

Horror films suck these days because they are, effectively, what currency is to the Federal Bank. They can be made so cheaply, and the quality of the film doesn't matter because they are so cheap that they are guaranteed to break even, even if the movie doesn't make all that much in the BO. They are effectively only made because they can be made so cheaply, and when you only make something for the money, it will be utter crap.
